contexts.text: When they live in charity, and adore the Deity the Creator of the universe... AC 2049.
(Aristotle's idea of a Supreme Deity.) SE 3951.
They were examined as to whether they believed in any... Supreme Deity... They said that they could not have an idea of a living Deity. DMin 4722.
They suppose that if there be anything of Deity present it is in the order of nature...
They torment those who do not worship them as Deities.
Their descendants... began to worship (these representative images) as holy things, and at last as Deities.
If anyone honours (this love) so far as to say that... it is the Deity of the world, it loves him from the heart.
From his Own intelligence he believes himself to be a Deity.
The horrible fallacy that God has infused Himself into men, whence every man is a sort of Deity that lives of himself.
Some of these men they first worshipped as Divinities, and at last as gods.
(The Babylonian Spirits) worshipped these persons as Deities.

It was given to say to (this African Queen) that she knew there was a Deity who was above her, and that this would be to act against the Deity and His laws; she then was silent. She was profane, because she acknowledged a Deity, yet lived in this way.
